The stored lattice is the recovered run-2 MgAl2O4 cell. The source assigns the CaFe2O4 structure type but does not refine or publish target Mg/Al/O coordinates, so atom sites are not inferred. Pbnm is the source-axis setting of space-group 62 for the CaFe2O4 prototype. The lattice product differs slightly from the source's separately reported V0=240.3(2) A3 because all printed quantities are rounded.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Experimental method; Table 1; Section 3.1; Section 3.3; Figure 4.
- **Equation:** Section 3.3: Birch second-order finite-strain EOS with Eulerian strain and K0'=4.
- **V0:** Section 3.3: 240.3(2) A3 for the recovered CaFe2O4-type conventional cell.
- **K0:** Section 3.3: 211(+/-6) GPa, calculated as the normalized pressure of the single in-situ run-2 state after holding the separately measured V0 fixed.
- **Implicit k0 prime:** Second-order Birch finite strain fixes K0'=4; it is assumed rather than fitted or stored as a BM2 parameter.
- **Construction states:** Recovered zero-pressure cell fixes V0; the in-situ run-2 cell at the mean post-heating pressure of 33.4 GPa then determines K0 algebraically. This is not a regression fit.
- **Uncertainties:** The source says bulk-modulus uncertainty is calculated from the difference between ruby- and Pt-derived post-heating pressures; no covariance or confidence convention is published.

</details>

- **Alpha1:** Eq. (3) and Table 2: b0=1.64(24)e-8 K^-2; c0 is explicitly fixed to zero.
- **Dk dt:** Eq. (4), surrounding prose, and Table 2: -0.030(2) GPa/K; printed denominator partial K is a typographical error for partial T.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Sections 2.1-2.3; Section 3.1, Eqs. (1)-(8); Tables 1-2; Figures 2-4.
- **Equation:** Section 3.1, Eq. (1), p. 81: standard third-order Birch-Murnaghan reference isotherm.
- **V0:** Section 3.1 and Table 2: fitted 240.1(2) A3 unit-cell volume at 300 K; fixed in both thermal stages.
- **K0:** Section 3.1 and Table 2: 205(6) GPa; fixed in both thermal stages.
- **K0 prime:** Section 3.1 and Table 2: 4.1(3); fixed in both thermal stages and independent of temperature.
- **Tr:** Eq. (4) uses T-300; Table 1 and Figure 2 identify the reference compression measurements as 300 K.
- **Volume basis:** Table 1 reports orthorhombic axes a approximately 8.65, b approximately 9.96, c approximately 2.79 A and V approximately 240 A3, matching the conventional Z=4 CF cell already documented for this material. Printed V is preserved rather than recomputed from rounded axes.
- **Uncertainties:** Parenthetical errors are transcribed from Table 2. The article does not specify their confidence convention, a covariance matrix, or numerical least-squares weights.
- **Gamma0:** Table 2: 1.73(7); Eq. (8) uses gamma=gamma0\*(V/V0)^q.
- **Q:** Table 2: 2.03(37); second Eq. (7) uses theta=theta0\*exp((gamma0-gamma)/q).
- **Theta0:** Table 2: 1546(104) K.
- **N:** First Eq. (7) defines n per formula unit: MgAl2O4 has 7 atoms. The loader converts Z=4 conventional-cell volumes to molar formula-unit volumes.
- **Thermal equation interpretation:** Eq. (6) misprints the energy difference in the denominator; use gamma/V times \[Eth(V,T)-Eth(V,300)\]. The first Eq. (7) misprints the Debye lower integration limit as theta; use zero. The literal printed versions are dimensionally inconsistent and fail the zero-increment reference identity. The interpreted standard Debye form reproduces Table 1 and the Figure 4 ambient expansion; both equations numbered (7) are distinguished here.

</details>
